narration: Your kick lands too high. The sled turns broadside and slams the curb; every crate answers with a glass chorus. Both masks snap toward you. One guard vaults the sinkhole while the other draws a spear behind the stalled cargo, leaving you on the ledge with retreat open but the shipment between them. The bell begins ringing by itself. Their surprise is gone; yours is not yet a surrender.

ruling.understoodAction: Resolve Sleight of Hand 10 against DC 12.
ruling.ruling: Failure; the sled stalls loudly and both guards engage.
